invariants.INV01: paint reads an immutable published generation; no core calls or live entity pointers
invariants.INV02: only core-authorized appearances, positions, layers and effects enter presentation
invariants.INV03: display sampling is owned by core preparation; repeat paint and UI timers consume no RNG
invariants.INV04: events describe selected legal attempts/results, never infer success from legacy entry hooks
invariants.INV05: projectile/beam/explosion paths contain only explicitly authorized public samples
invariants.INV06: level/session/entity/view generations invalidate stale motion and hidden actors
invariants.INV07: animation adds no command, turn, rule delay, input gate or nested core dispatch
invariants.INV08: one monotonic presentation timestamp per frame drives actor and camera; no core calendar read
invariants.INV09: typed private projections protect all rule state, knowledge, control and both RNG streams
invariants.INV10: record/control every core clock and seed source throughout process lifetime without state injection
invariants.INV11: fresh post-improvement fixtures; ordinary save format and default loader remain authoritative
invariants.INV12: metadata/file bindings, full semantic differences and predeclared normalization only
invariants.INV13: native EN and JA source/field/notification maps audited separately
invariants.INV14: idle checkpoint/save writes are explicit core operations, never counted as pure painting

field_binding_policy: every active rule field and private mutable rule static must be bound or explicitly reviewed; no silent omission
view_exclusions: presentation-only fields require an exact predeclared path/source/reason; no heuristic wildcard exclusions
event_payload: copied public values and opaque generation-scoped display handles; no true entity/object id or pointer
legacy_animation_policy: phase0 removes production legacy attack hooks and live-position inference before accepted baseline; never run alongside new notifications
